events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' on the world. A double album packed with classics and experimental tracks – which song is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day. His incredible voice and showmanship continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' album, released today in 1965. A pivotal moment, blending folk-rock with pop perfection.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of The Beatles' John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist and peace activist whose music continues to resonate globally. Imagine all the people...

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic British musician David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. Forever a musical chameleon and true icon.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today would have been the 92nd birthday of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today. The King lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite riff from the master?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.}

angles.name: Rock & Roll Legend
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still rocking stages around the world. What's your go-to Rod Stewart anthem?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and musician Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the voice behind so many 80s hits, Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Come Back and Stay', a true legend.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music icon, singer-songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music, film, and philanthropy. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow, lead vocalist of Take That, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Legend
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday.}

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with his timeless hits today.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held in New York City.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: Throwing it back to this day in 1989: the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony! Who was in that inaugural class? (Hint: think legends!)

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, best known as a member of Take That, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming us with his unique style.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London! What an incredible final public performance.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo career, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: English actor and film producer Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Romantic Comedy King
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to dramatic roles, he's a true British screen icon.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.}

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.
